name: Davis Summer 2024
information: ![](https://i.imgur.com/jmSpkQE.png) Get ready for our third competition in Davis! ## Notice: Our venue has changed! ### *We have moved from the ARC Ballroom in UC Davis to the Veterans Memorial Center, which is slightly north of the UC Davis campus. Check the Location/Parking/Food tab for more info.* **Competition Day Timing** - The competition will begin at the scheduled start time. - Lunch will end at the scheduled time. - Events will begin as soon as the previous event is wrapping up. Exception: All First Round events will not start more than 20 minutes early. - Competitors may not compete in an event if they miss last call for that event. In general, last call is a few minutes after the last group is called.
